description: Cancel an appointment (id from my_schedule), freeing the time. Confirm with the owner first. Anything the client paid at booking, and any tip, is refunded in full — the pro cancelling is never the client's fault. Texts the client only with notify_client: true — ask the owner, especially for a client who booked themselves online or through Claude.

notify_client.description: Text the client that it's cancelled.
